scenario: Multiple parent fires create independent timers per LTAC.4.3 — each parent activation asserts a separate timer fact; two fires create two timers; both follow-ups eventually fire. Pin: two different triggers → both after-clauses fire (two `$..._after_0` firings).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule notify:
    Trig t
->
    log info "triggered"
    after 3_s:
        log info "delayed: {t.entity_id}"
